description: Na₂GdTa₅O₁₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mbm space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (2.72 Å) and four longer (2.91 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Gd is bonded to twelve O atoms to form GdO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with two equivalent GdO₁₂ cuboctahedra and faces with eight equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.60 Å) and eight longer (2.67 Å) Gd-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ta sites. In the first Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-32°. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and four longer (2.00 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. In the second Ta site, Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TaO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent GdO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-41°. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.05 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two Ta atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Gd and two equivalent Ta atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ta atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Ta atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Gd and two equivalent Ta atoms.
